title: WPSS/572/2010 of RANJEET SINGH Vs EXECUTIVE ENGINEER, UPPER GANGA CANAL  and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 572 of 2010

Versus
Executive Engineer, Upper Ganga Canal Modernization,
Division-VI (W.B.), Roorkee, District Haridwar & others
 Ö.ÖRespondents
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
1. Ms. Neetu Singh, Advocate present for the
petitioner.
2. None present for the State of
U.P./respondents.
3. The petitioner is working on the post of
Electrician since 1999 and though he was an employee of
Uttar Pradesh and presently working in the territory of
Uttarakhand. Hence, the present writ petition before this
Court.
4. The petitioner claims regular salary of an
Electrician, which he is not being given. In the counter
affidavit, the State of Uttar Pradesh justified its stand by
saying that the petitioner does not have the qualification for
appointment on the post of Electrician such as Diploma
from ITI (Industrial Training Institute). The petitioner on
the other hand, has pointed out that the order dated
06.08.1999 by which his services were regularized, his
qualifications were relaxed as the petitioner had already an
experience of more than ten years on the post of
Electrician. This finding contained in the order dated
06.08.1999.
5. The petitioner has brought this fact to his
benefit and state that now respondents cannot go back and
denied the pay scale of Electrician on the grounds of his
qualification. No rules have been shown by the petitioner to
this Court in order to strengthen his claim. There is no

2
counsel who is representing the State of Uttar Pradesh
before this Court as of now. Although the matter is listed in
the weekly cause list.
6. The writ petition stands disposed with the
direction to the Executive Engineer, Upper Ganga Canal
Modernization, Division-VI (W.B.), Roorkee, District
Haridwar, who shall decide the representation of the
petitioner within a period of three weeks from the date of
production of a certified copy of this order and thereafter
within a period of six weeks the Executive Engineer, Upper
Ganga Canal Modernization, Division-VI (W.B.), Roorkee,
District Haridwar shall pass consequential order.
7. With the aforesaid observations, the writ
petition stands disposed. No order as to costs.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 20.11.2015
Nitesh
